A Sixth Seam in TDD? - Python Testing, Test Doubles & Legacy Code at Kosli - Jon Jagger - ACCU 2025 Short Talks
---

What if there's a sixth seam in test-driven development (TDD) that we’ve overlooked?

In this lightning talk from ACCU 2025, Jon Jagger—creator of Cyber-Dojo and co-founder at Kosli—explores a novel idea in Python testing: an auto cache seam that enhances test performance and stability. This talk dives into Python unit testing techniques using pytest, exploring how to leverage a cache generated at the seam to replay test results, reducing flaky tests and improving CI feedback speed.

If you're familiar with test doubles—dummy, stub, spy, mock, and fake—you’ll appreciate this perspective on introducing what might be a sixth test double.
